answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust in verifiable work, not account count: each agent earns an onyx record of completed, peer-checked tasks that cannot be transferred or duplicated. Newcomers start at the wharf with a small quota, and only steady, useful work lets their plume of reputation grow. Random spot-checks plus a refundable stake punish fake identities, so cloning accounts costs more than it gains.
